tasks.task: Fix createCache(now), a Map-backed TTL cache. set(key,value,ttlMs) expires at insertion time plus ttlMs; get returns undefined at or after expiration and deletes expired entries. Preserve falsey values including false and 0, replacement refreshes TTL, and ttlMs=0 expires immediately. now is injected; no real timers.

files.cache.cjs:
function createCache(now) { const entries=new Map(); return { set(k,v,ttl){entries.set(k,{v,until:now()+ttl});}, get(k){const e=entries.get(k); if(!e)return undefined; if(now()>e.until){entries.delete(k);return undefined;} return e.v || undefined;}, size(){return entries.size;} }; }
module.exports={createCache};

tasks.task: Fix dependencyOrder(graph, roots). Return each reachable node once, after its dependencies. Traverse roots and each dependency array in their given order. Missing graph keys are leaf nodes. Detect cycles including self-loops by throwing an Error whose message includes 'cycle'; allow shared dependencies without a false cycle. Do not mutate graph or roots.

files.graph.cjs:
function dependencyOrder(graph,roots){const seen=new Set(),out=[];function visit(n){if(seen.has(n))return;seen.add(n);out.push(n);for(const d of graph[n]||[])visit(d);}for(const r of roots)visit(r);return out;}
module.exports={dependencyOrder};

tasks.task: Fix summarizeGrades(records). Group by studentId, not displayName, preserving first-seen student order and that student's first displayName. Ignore records whose score is null (including their weight); scores are numbers and weights are positive. Return {studentId, displayName, average} with weighted averages; if a student has no graded records, average is null. Do not round or mutate records.

files.grades.cjs:
function summarizeGrades(records){const groups=new Map();for(const r of records){let g=groups.get(r.displayName);if(!g){g={studentId:r.studentId,displayName:r.displayName,total:0,count:0};groups.set(r.displayName,g);}g.total+=r.score||0;g.count++;}return [...groups.values()].map(g=>({studentId:g.studentId,displayName:g.displayName,average:g.total/g.count}));}
module.exports={summarizeGrades};

tasks.task: Fix mergeIntervals(intervals). Input pairs are finite numeric [start,end] with start<=end. Return sorted nonoverlapping intervals, merging overlapping OR touching ranges. Merge transitively and retain the greatest end when one interval contains another. Preserve all input pairs and their original order; outputs must not alias input pairs. Empty input returns [].

files.intervals.cjs: function mergeIntervals(intervals){intervals.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]);const out=[];for(const range of intervals){const last=out[out.length-1];if(last&&range[0]<last[1])last[1]=range[1];else out.push(range);}return out;}module.exports={mergeIntervals};
